visual_evidence: Dark, water-soaked brown lesions on leaf margins and stems
Pale green halo surrounding brown necrotized leaf tissue
White downy fungal growth visible on undersides of leaves during humid conditions
immediate_actions: Prune and destroy severely infected lower leaves immediately.
Discontinue overhead sprinkler irrigation to keep canopy dry.
organic_treatment: Spray Copper Hydroxide or Copper Oxychloride (2.5 g/L) as a bio-protectant barrier.
Apply bio-fungicide containing Trichoderma harzianum (5 ml/L) weekly.
chemical_treatment: Systemic option: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/L of water.
Curative option: Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1 g/L or Cyazofamid 34.5% SC @ 0.6 ml/L.
what_not_to_do: Do NOT spray contact fungicides if rain is expected within 3–4 hours.
Do NOT leave infected crop residues on field soil surface.
preventive_measures: Maintain 60 cm row spacing for optimal air circulation.
Rotate crops with non-solanaceous species (e.g. maize, legumes).

visual_evidence: Concentric target-board ring patterns inside brown leaf spots
Chlorotic yellowing of surrounding older leaf blade
immediate_actions: Remove infected lower leaves touching soil surface.
Apply organic mulch around stem base to prevent fungal spore splash.
organic_treatment: Spray Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE 5%) or Neem Oil (3 ml/L).
Foliar application of Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/L.
chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/L.
Option: Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.5 ml/L of water.
what_not_to_do: Do NOT apply excessive Nitrogen fertilizer.
Do NOT spray when ambient temperature exceeds 34°C.
preventive_measures: Use drip irrigation to keep foliage completely dry.
Stake tomato plants vertically to keep leaves off soil.

visual_evidence: Small dark brown water-soaked angular spots on leaf lamina
Yellow halo surrounding dark necrotized lesions
Scabby dark raised spots on developing fruit
immediate_actions: Sanitize hands and pruning shears after touching infected plants.
Avoid working in field while foliage is wet with dew.
organic_treatment: Spray Copper Hydroxide (2 g/L) combined with bio-protectants.
chemical_treatment: Bactericide spray: Streptomycin Sulfate + Tetracycline Combination @ 0.5 g/L with Copper Oxychloride @ 2 g/L.
what_not_to_do: Do NOT handle plants when wet with rain or overhead irrigation.
preventive_measures: Hot water seed treatment at 50°C for 25 minutes before sowing.

visual_evidence: Upward leaf cupping and yellowing of young leaves
Stunted bush-like plant habit and flower drop
Prominent whitefly vector presence on leaf undersides
immediate_actions: Uproot and destroy viral-infected plants early.
Install yellow sticky traps @ 20/acre to capture whitefly vectors.
organic_treatment: Foliar spray of Neem Oil 10,000 ppm @ 3 ml/L with soap spreader.
chemical_treatment: Target vector: Spray Afidopyropen 50 g/L DC @ 2 ml/L or Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.2 g/L.
what_not_to_do: Do NOT allow weed hosts (Parthenium, Abutilon) to flourish near bunds.
preventive_measures: Use insect-proof net screen houses (40-mesh) for nursery seedlings.

visual_evidence: Oval dark brown spots with yellow chlorotic margins
Lesions evenly scattered across paddy leaf blade
Discolored grains on affected panicles
immediate_actions: Top-dress soil with Potassium (MOP) and Zinc to correct nutrient deficiency.
Maintain 3–5 cm standing water level in field.
organic_treatment: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 10 g/kg seed.
Foliar spray of 5% Neem leaf extract twice.
chemical_treatment: Foliar spray of Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 2 ml/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L.
what_not_to_do: Do NOT let field dry out during boot-leaf stage.
Do NOT spray during high wind speeds (> 15 km/h).
preventive_measures: Apply balanced NPK fertilization with micro-nutrients.

visual_evidence: Spindle-shaped lesions with gray center and reddish-brown margin
Coalescing spots causing leaf drying and neck rot
immediate_actions: Drain excess standing water temporarily if over-fertilized with Nitrogen.
organic_treatment: Spray Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 2.5 kg/ha in FYM.
chemical_treatment: Foliar spray of Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/L of water.
what_not_to_do: Do NOT apply excess urea during humid overcast weather.
preventive_measures: Seed treatment with Tricyclazole @ 2 g/kg seed.

visual_evidence: Upward or downward leaf curling
Thickening of leaf veins on lower surface forming cup-like enations
immediate_actions: Uproot severely stunted viral infected plants.
Control whitefly vectors on border crops.
organic_treatment: Foliar spray of Neem Oil 10,000 ppm @ 2 ml/L.
chemical_treatment: Target vector: Spray Afidopyropen @ 2 ml/L or Spirotetramat + Imidacloprid @ 1 ml/L.
what_not_to_do: Do NOT spray pyrethroids which cause whitefly resurgence.
preventive_measures: Plant border crops like Pearl Millet or Sorghum as physical vector barrier.

visual_evidence: Golden-brown to cinnamon pustules erupting on leaf surfaces
Powdery rust spores rubbing off on touch
immediate_actions: Initiate treatment if rust affects leaves near ear level early in grain filling.
organic_treatment: Foliar spray of Sulfur 80% WDG @ 3 g/L as eco-friendly rust barrier.
chemical_treatment: Foliar spray of Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1 ml/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L.
what_not_to_do: Do NOT spray sulfur when temperature exceeds 33°C to avoid leaf burn.

visual_evidence: Dark brown/black blighted patches on leaf blade
White mildew ring on lower leaf surface during high humidity
immediate_actions: Apply protective fungicide spray before rain.
Earthing up soil around potato hills to protect tubers.
chemical_treatment: Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Fluopicolide + Propamocarb @ 1.5 ml/L.
what_not_to_do: Do NOT harvest tubers while foliage is actively blighted.

visual_evidence: Uniform green chlorophyll distribution across leaf lamina
Intact leaf margins free of necrotic lesions
immediate_actions: Continue routine field scouting and drip moisture management.
organic_treatment: Apply preventative bio-stimulants (Seaweed extract 2 ml/L) to maintain immunity.
what_not_to_do: Do NOT spray unnecessary pesticides when crop is healthy.
preventive_measures: Regular field scouting twice a week.
